title: Transfer a genuine relative signed-exit margin under rate errors
statement: Using the accepted bounded inward word,choose a fixed-radius reachable neighbourhood S_x={z:|z-x|1<=r,Phi(z)>Phi(x)-c_R N}. The word gives A_x>=c_R N[kappa_min/(4J(1+N+r)^D)]^L_R but NO bound on B_x. IF an allowed nominal design actually satisfies B_x<=(1-eta)A_x outside a polynomial head,eta in(0,1/2],then finite-exit comparisons imply Btilde/Atilde<=alpha_delta^(2m)(1-eta). Rational delta<=eta/(64m) gives Btilde<=(1-eta/2)Atilde andEtilde[Delta Phi]<=-(eta/4)Etilde|Delta Phi|. This transfers an actual nominal relative bias independently of arbitrarily many local failures; it neither constructs the bias for allR nor treats a favorable word as a negative expected exit drift.

assumptions: Finite-exit perturbation and cost theorems are unconditional under their stated finite-exit hypothesis. The full compiler theorem is CONDITIONAL on an ACTUALLY proved nominal signed-exit bias with polynomial margin/head for an allowed design. One inward original word bounds A_x below but does not control B_x; finitely many local rational patterns or sampled populations do not establish the global sign. The proof supplies finite-horizon polynomial moments,not an unproved uniform-in-time transient estimate. Stationary moments and actual activity are paid separately. Captured native prefix contains Sections1–6; Section7 discussion is cut and remaining response/activity are not supplied. Citation tokens remain source-reported,not new Capital primary reads. No global positivity test,full universal design,practical implementation,priority or independent audit is claimed. All source/access/transfer/resource holds remain.
costs: No internal firing is free. Positive tree ratios use at mostm physical factors and yield errors alpha_delta^+/-m,alpha_delta=(1+delta)/(1-delta),without a path-length cutoff. At fixed radius,p_x=kappa_min/[4J(1+N+r)^D],E F_S<=m p_x^-m andE tau_S<=2m p_x^-m/kappa_min; every fixed moment is polynomial. With actual signed margin,delta<=eta/(64m) and a later smaller reciprocal-polynomial accuracy tolerance pay all unknown errors. Exact local rational systems have fixed size; numerator degree<=mD+1 and population-dependent bit arithmetic is polynomial. Conditional compiler bit work/memory/output are polynomial in complete binary input length; T,delta^-1,inverse nominal rates and expected ALL actual firings are polynomial in W=2+|x0|1+sum(lambda_i+lambda_i^-1)+epsilon^-1. Proof-only reset/memory variables change no physical rate or population. No trajectory,stationary-law or coefficient oracle is supplied or run by Capital.

obstruction: Construct an allowed design with the global signed-exit margin and paid polynomial constants,or supply another complete all-R robust construction or a genuine all-design obstruction. Do not infer the margin from one successful word or a finite population fixture.
